description: Seed gold set over the n8n-hermes-agents repository (AHAWR workflows, Hermes compression script, docs and the retrieval service itself). Tasks are phrased like Architect plan entries; judgments name path + symbol/section and were checked by hand against the repository at the commit that introduced this file. Extend with real AHAWR missions; re-run validate-dataset after repository changes.

provenance.status: seed: needs review by a maintainer before being treated as authoritative
provenance.review: judgments extended once by pooled review of the top-5 of the first run (module docstrings that state the requested rule)

task.title: Compression must target the role-specific Hermes session
task.objective: The TUI compression RPC must receive the session selected by the compression-target path (worker_session_id or reviewer_session_id) and never silently substitute the Architect session.
acceptance_criteria: session.compress is called with the requested session_id
verification: Run hermes_compress.py against a worker session and inspect the resumed session id

task.title: Explain compression failures reported as unsupported model
task.objective: A compression result shows status aborted, compression_failed true, removed 0 and 'Model ... is not supported'. Document the cause and where the compression model is configured.

task.title: Validate retry_delays_json in the runtime configuration
task.objective: retry_delays_json in hermes_config must be a JSON array of non-negative numbers; document the default delay sequence used for provider retries.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid retry_delays_json fails with a clear error

task.title: Make semantic cache reuse stricter for reviewer feedback
task.objective: Semantic equivalence of query fingerprints must require identical anchors (paths, identifiers) and a configurable Jaccard threshold per profile before a cached retrieval is reused.
acceptance_criteria: Threshold comes from the profile cache config

relevant.note: module docstring defines the equivalence levels (added in pooled review)
module docstring defines cache key dimensions (added in pooled review)

task.title: Manual invalidation must survive routine incremental syncs
task.objective: Chunks invalidated through the invalidate endpoint must stay invalidated when the workspace is re-synced and the file content is unchanged; they become active again only after a content change or an explicit reindex.

review.feedback: Invalidated chunks come back after the next sync; the unchanged-hash shortcut revalidates them.

variants.feedback: invalidated chunks come back after the next sync -- the unchanged hash shortcut revalidates them!
After the next sync the invalidated chunks come back, because the unchanged-hash shortcut revalidates them.
Invalidated chunks come back after the next sync; also check retrieval-service/src/ahawr_retrieval/store.py deactivate_chunk.
Embeddings are recomputed for every chunk of a changed file instead of only the modified chunk.

task.title: Drop expired documentation chunks deterministically
task.objective: Documentation chunks whose valid_until is in the past, or whose version differs from a pinned doc_versions entry, must be removed by the hard filters before reranking.

task.title: Fall back to the local index when rag-platform is down
task.objective: A transport error or 5xx from rag-platform must open a circuit breaker for the configured cooldown and serve the request from the local backend with a degraded reason.

task.title: Cross-encoder must score only query and chunk text
task.objective: The reranker request to reranker-service must contain only the query and the chunk text; path, symbol, freshness and other metadata must not be sent to the cross-encoder.

relevant.note: module docstring states the text-only rule (added in pooled review)

task.title: Enable the retrieval layer for a mission in n8n
task.objective: Describe which hermes_config columns turn on retrieval for the Worker and Reviewer, how corpora and the workspace root are configured, and where reranker and rag-platform settings are supplied.

relevant.section: Build n8n with the retrieval layer

task.title: Проверить state_namespace у новой миссии
task.objective: Новая миссия должна иметь непустой state_namespace, чтобы persistent state разных миссий не пересекался. Найти, где это проверяется и описано.

task.title: Manual invalidation must survive routine incremental syncs
task.objective: Invalidated chunks stay invalidated across syncs of unchanged files and are reactivated only by content changes or explicit reindex.
acceptance_criteria: A test covers touch() of an invalidated file followed by sync
Changed chunk becomes active, unchanged chunk stays invalidated
